about: All the definitive elements of the Octopath Traveler series return in this exciting prequel set in the realm of Orsterra. Embark on a brand new adventure of your own creation in this stunning HD-2D RPG, Octopath Traveler 0!
Brand-new features to the series include a character creation system where you get to become the hero, and town building mechanics as you seek to restore your devastated home.
summary: All the definitive elements of the Octopath Traveler series return in this exciting prequel set in the realm of Orsterra.
